freeze_rule: AIFC v1.0 MUST NOT be labeled FROZEN unless every required check has machine-verifiable PASS evidence bound into an AIFC/release-manifest/v1 object and the manifest itself verifies.
forbidden_shortcuts: manual override of failed conformance gate
dropping attack vectors from the frozen corpus after observing failures
using one implementation twice as independent implementations
claiming canonical equivalence without byte-identical test-vector results
claiming complete reporting without a verified global trial ledger
declaring K_i=1 without admitted candidate-generation provenance
reconfiguring witness membership without a jointly certified registry transition
choosing target transformation after target observation
accepting mathematically equivalent but byte-noncanonical rational bounds
setting FROZEN_PASS without per-gate evidence hashes
